theme_strategy: Hybrid theme architecture: Dark mode forced for Vendor Dashboard, Light mode forced for Public Cancellation Portal. Marketing page utilizes both to transition the narrative.

vendor_dashboard.scale_rules: H1 max text-5xl, tracking-tight. Overlines/Labels text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em].
vendor_dashboard.rationale: High-density data requires sterile, clear monoline-like proportions for numbers.

cancellation_portal.scale_rules: H2 text-3xl for survey questions. Leading-relaxed for body text to lower cognitive load.
cancellation_portal.rationale: Friendly, rounded humanist fonts reduce user anxiety and friction during the cancellation process.

marketing.scale_rules: Radical weight contrast (e.g., font-black for value prop, font-light for subtext). H1 max text-6xl.
marketing.rationale: Assertive and brutalist-leaning for high-ticket B2B credibility.

cancellation_portal.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity) mixed with Soft Utility

vendor_dashboard: The Tracing Beam: Use framer-motion to create glowing 1px border trails on high-value KPI cards (MRR Recovered).
Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layout for data tables.
Glow: Add blur-md emerald glows under positive trend charts.
cancellation_portal: Neumorphism (Tactile): Soft ambient shadows shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] paired with a sharp 1px border-black/5 to ground the wizard container.
Minimalist Progress: Stepper should be hyper-minimal, just 2-3 thin lines, no massive circles.

component name.dashboard_kpi_card: Cardless rectangular, 1px solid border-white/10, no shadow, emerald hover lift (-translate-y-1).
component name.cancellation_wizard: Asymmetrical split screen: Left side clean form/survey, right side minimal calming nature visual or dynamic offer breakdown.
component name.offer_manager_crud: Dense data table, 1px subtle borders, inline toggles for active/inactive offers.
component name.charts: Shadcn Recharts. Area charts with emerald gradient fill (opacity 0.2 to 0) for MRR Recovered.

grids.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density Grid). Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids.marketing: Tetris Grid Protocol Mode A. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12. Wide gaps (gap-12). Aggressive asymmetry.

layouts.cancellation_flow: Split-screen layout. 60% left for form interaction, 40% right for value reinforcement or calming visual. Avoid centered 'Bootstrap' boxes.
layouts.dashboard_view: Fixed sidebar navigation (glassmorphism if scrolling under), dense top bar with global search, main content area with strict grid hierarchy. Spacing: p-6 or p-8 internal padding for widgets.

motion.wizard_transitions: Framer Motion layout animations. Slide-up and fade-in (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1, duration 0.4s easeOut) between step 1 (Reason), step 2 (Offer), and step 3 (Success/Goodbye).
motion.dashboard_microinteractions: Row hover states in Analytics table. Subtle number counter animations for KPI blocks on load.
motion.marketing_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling. React Spring Parallax for floating dashboard UI elements over the hero background.

accessibility.contrast: APCA and WCAG AA standards. Ensure all text in the Cancellation Flow exceeds 4.5:1. Never use transparent dropdown backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 (dashboard) or focus:ring-primary (portal).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all Framer Motion and Lenis scroll effects.
accessibility.testing: All key elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='cancel-reason-radio', data-testid='kpi-mrr-recovered').

media.images: Hero overlay max bg-black/50 or bg-black/30 for dark themes. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.
media.icons: Phosphor Icons for Dashboard (dense, precise). Heroicons for Cancellation portal (clean, soft).

3d libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for Dashboard analytics (2D clarity is paramount). Use framer-motion for Wizard. No heavy 3D required, keep it performant. If marketing needs punch, use Spline for a lightweight abstract data visualization in the hero.

image urls.description: Textured green abstract lines representing data and growth, use for marketing hero section.
Business people analyzing dashboard. Use in the marketing 'Why ChurnGuard' section.
Calm foggy landscape. Use on the right side of the split-screen cancellation wizard to evoke calm and reduce churn anxiety.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dual-theme architecture. Vendor Dashboard must be built in a forced dark mode (#0B0F19 background with #10B981 accents). Public cancellation portal must be forced light mode (#F9FAFB background).
All React code MUST be written in JavaScript (.jsx/.js). Do not generate TypeScript (.tsx) files or TypeScript-specific Shadcn components.
Implement Shadcn Recharts for the 'Top Cancellation Reasons' and 'MRR Recovered' charts.
Do NOT build the cancellation step wizard with complex routing. Use a single page component with framer-motion conditional rendering for steps.
In the Dashboard, use purely border-based card designs (border-white/10). No soft box-shadows.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to all actionable buttons and form inputs.
Do not center-align the main form in the cancellation flow. Use the requested split layout with the nature image on the right.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the typography constraints properly (Outfit/Cabinet Grotesk for headings).
Never use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do not center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
All interactions need micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) to avoid cramped UI.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Use `sonner` for all toast notifications, implemented via .js/.jsx.
